#!/bin/bash
# SOCKS5 proxy (Dante) multi-IP installer
# Features: Unique auto-generated passwords per IP (User: root), persistent netplan, instant change-pass tool
# Based on: https://github.com/BRAVO-IT/VPN (author: BRAVO_IT)

set -u

if [ "$(id -u)" -ne 0 ]; then
    echo "Please run as root (use sudo)."
    exit 1
fi

EXTRA_RAW="${1:-}"
PORT="${2:-8080}"
PROXY_USER="root"
[ "$EXTRA_RAW" = "-" ] && EXTRA_RAW=""

# ---- Network Detection ----------------------------------------------------
IFACE=$(ip -4 route get 8.8.8.8 | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="dev"){print $(i+1); exit}}')
MAIN_IP=$(ip -4 route get 8.8.8.8 | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="src"){print $(i+1); exit}}')
if [ -z "$IFACE" ] || [ -z "$MAIN_IP" ]; then
    echo "Could not detect the network interface or main IP."
    exit 1
fi

# ---- Kernel multi-subnet support (rp_filter) ------------------------------
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter=2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter=2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
sysctl -w net.ipv4.conf."${IFACE}".rp_filter=2 >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

cat << 'SYSCTL' > /etc/sysctl.d/99-rp-filter.conf
net.ipv4.conf.all.rp_filter = 2
net.ipv4.conf.default.rp_filter = 2
SYSCTL

# ---- Install Dependencies -------------------------------------------------
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq dante-server libpam-pwdfile openssl curl iputils-arping

# ---- Add and Announce Extra IPs -------------------------------------------
EXTRA_IPS=""
if [ -n "$EXTRA_RAW" ]; then
    for ip in $(echo "$EXTRA_RAW" | tr ',; \t\r' '\n\n\n\n\n'); do
        [ -z "$ip" ] && continue
        if ! echo "$ip" | grep -Eq '^([0-9]{1,3}\.){3}[0-9]{1,3}$'; then
            continue
        fi
        [ "$ip" = "$MAIN_IP" ] && continue

        EXTRA_IPS="$EXTRA_IPS $ip"
        ip addr show dev "$IFACE" | grep -qw "inet ${ip}/32" || ip addr add "${ip}/32" dev "$IFACE"
        arping -U -c 2 -w 1 -I "$IFACE" "$ip" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    done

    # Persist in Netplan across reboots
    if [ -n "$EXTRA_IPS" ] && command -v netplan >/dev/null 2>&1; then
        {
            echo "network:"
            echo "  version: 2"
            echo "  ethernets:"
            echo "    ${IFACE}:"
            echo "      addresses:"
            for ip in $EXTRA_IPS; do echo "        - ${ip}/32"; done
        } > /etc/netplan/60-extra-ip.yaml
        chmod 600 /etc/netplan/60-extra-ip.yaml
        netplan apply >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
    fi
fi

# ---- Systemd Multi-Instance Service ---------------------------------------
systemctl stop danted >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
systemctl disable danted >/dev/null 2>&1 || true

cat << 'EOF' > /etc/systemd/system/danted@.service
[Unit]
Description=SOCKS5 proxy daemon for %I
After=network-online.target
Wants=network-online.target

[Service]
Type=simple
ExecStart=/usr/sbin/danted -f /etc/danted-%i.conf -p /run/danted-%i.pid
Restart=always
RestartSec=5

[Install]
WantedBy=multi-user.target
EOF
systemctl daemon-reload

# ---- Configure Each IP with its own Random Password ----------------------
ALL_IPS=$(ip -4 -o addr show dev "$IFACE" scope global 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
NODE_LIST=()

for ip in $ALL_IPS; do
    NODE_PASS=$(openssl rand -hex 6 2>/dev/null || tr -dc 'a-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 12)

    # 1. Password file for this IP
    echo "${PROXY_USER}:$(openssl passwd -1 "$NODE_PASS")" > "/etc/danted-${ip}.passwd"
    chmod 600 "/etc/danted-${ip}.passwd"

    # 2. PAM service file for this IP
    cat << EOF > "/etc/pam.d/sockd-${ip}"
auth required pam_pwdfile.so nodelay pwdfile=/etc/danted-${ip}.passwd
account required pam_permit.so
EOF

    # 3. Dante configuration for this IP
    cat << EOF > "/etc/danted-${ip}.conf"
logoutput: syslog

internal.protocol: ipv4
internal: ${ip} port=${PORT}

external.protocol: ipv4
external: ${ip}

socksmethod: pam.any

user.privileged: root
user.notprivileged: nobody

client pass {
        from: 0.0.0.0/0 to: 0.0.0.0/0
        log: error
}

socks block {
        from: 0.0.0.0/0 to: 127.0.0.0/8
}

socks pass {
        from: 0.0.0.0/0 to: 0.0.0.0/0
        pamservicename: sockd-${ip}
        command: bind connect udpassociate
        log: error
}
EOF

    # Enable & Start
    systemctl enable "danted@${ip}" >/dev/null 2>&1
    systemctl restart "danted@${ip}"

    NODE_LIST+=("${ip}:${PORT}:${PROXY_USER}:${NODE_PASS}")
done

# ---- Firewall -------------------------------------------------------------
if command -v ufw >/dev/null 2>&1 && ufw status | grep -q "Status: active"; then
    ufw allow "${PORT}/tcp" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
fi

# ---- Install 'change-pass' Tool -------------------------------------------
cat << 'EOF' > /usr/local/bin/change-pass
#!/bin/bash
set -u

if [ "$#" -lt 1 ]; then
    echo "Usage: change-pass <IP> [OPTIONAL_CUSTOM_PASSWORD]"
    echo "       change-pass all"
    exit 1
fi

TARGET_IP="$1"
CUSTOM_PASS="${2:-}"

update_ip() {
    local ip="$1"
    local new_pass="$2"

    if [ -z "$new_pass" ]; then
        new_pass=$(openssl rand -hex 6 2>/dev/null || tr -dc 'a-z0-9' </dev/urandom | head -c 12)
    fi

    local pass_file="/etc/danted-${ip}.passwd"

    if [ -f "$pass_file" ] || [ -f "/etc/danted-${ip}.conf" ]; then
        echo "root:$(openssl passwd -1 "$new_pass")" > "$pass_file"
        chmod 600 "$pass_file"
    else
        echo "root:$(openssl passwd -1 "$new_pass")" > /etc/danted.passwd
    fi

    local out
    out=$(curl -s -m 8 --socks5-hostname "${ip}:8080" --proxy-user "root:${new_pass}" https://ifconfig.me 2>/dev/null || true)
    
    if [ "$out" = "$ip" ]; then
        echo "Address  : ${ip} -> [OK]"
        echo "New Node : ${ip}:8080:root:${new_pass}"
    else
        echo "Address  : ${ip} -> [FAILED to connect]"
        echo "New Node : ${ip}:8080:root:${new_pass}"
    fi
}

echo "================================================================"
if [ "$TARGET_IP" = "all" ]; then
    echo "   ROTATING PASSWORDS FOR ALL PROXY NODES (AUTO-GENERATE)       "
    echo "================================================================"
    IFACE=$(ip -4 route get 8.8.8.8 | awk '{for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="dev"){print $(i+1); exit}}')
    ALL_IPS=$(ip -4 -o addr show dev "$IFACE" scope global 2>/dev/null | awk '{print $4}' | cut -d/ -f1)
    for ip in $ALL_IPS; do
        update_ip "$ip" ""
        echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
    done
else
    echo "   UPDATING PASSWORD FOR ${TARGET_IP} (AUTO-GENERATE)           "
    echo "================================================================"
    update_ip "$TARGET_IP" "$CUSTOM_PASS"
fi
echo "================================================================"
EOF
chmod +x /usr/local/bin/change-pass

sleep 2

# ---- Output Node List & Test ----------------------------------------------
echo ""
echo "================================================================"
echo "          YOUR SOCKS5 PROXIES (USER: root, RANDOM PASS)         "
echo "================================================================"
echo "Proxy List (IP:Port:User:Pass):"
for node in "${NODE_LIST[@]}"; do
    echo "  $node"
done
echo "----------------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Testing Live Nodes:"

for node in "${NODE_LIST[@]}"; do
    node_ip=$(echo "$node" | cut -d: -f1)
    node_port=$(echo "$node" | cut -d: -f2)
    node_user=$(echo "$node" | cut -d: -f3)
    node_pass=$(echo "$node" | cut -d: -f4)

    OUT=$(curl -s -m 8 --socks5-hostname "${node_ip}:${node_port}" \
            --proxy-user "${node_user}:${node_pass}" https://ifconfig.me 2>/dev/null || true)
    if [ "$OUT" = "$node_ip" ]; then
        echo "Address  : ${node_ip} (root)   -> exits as ${OUT}   [OK]"
    else
        echo "Address  : ${node_ip} (root)   -> [FAILED]"
    fi
done
echo "================================================================"
echo "Tip: To auto-generate a new password for any IP later, run:"
echo "     change-pass <IP>    (or: change-pass all)"
echo "================================================================"
